description: Inspect operational logs and endpoint telemetry; fix confirmed slow/failing endpoints and improve request/response contracts with focused validation.

acceptance_criteria: Measure and rank recurring latency/cost hot paths across MCP/API, retrieval/RAG, embedding/reranking, caches, indexing, scheduler and IPC using retained telemetry or bounded representative benchmarks.
For each candidate, record baseline, workload, sample count and limits; separate cold-start from steady-state and avoid attributing noisy synthetic changes to source.
Implement high-value safe optimizations for confirmed CPU, filesystem, SQLite or network bottlenecks with focused regressions and measured before/after evidence.

Evaluate compatible CPU, dedicated GPU, integrated GPU and NPU routes for embeddings/reranking; preserve explicit provider choice and CPU fallback; do not install providers or pull models without user opt-in.
Assess Rust/Cython only after profiling isolates CPU-bound work; document measured tradeoffs and do not add native code when I/O, serialization, database or model latency dominates.
Recent endpoint failures and latency hotspots are classified from retained telemetry and trace evidence.
Confirmed server or response-contract defects are fixed at their source with focused regression coverage.
Repetition detection releases the GPU fence only after the backend confirms completion; incomplete or timed-out streams remain fenced.
Focused checks pass and diff check is clean.
Live process has loaded the current source and representative endpoint/trace behavior is verified after the already authorized restart.
Opening #traceInspector directly loads retained trace summaries; request-history rows match by request_id; enabled HTTP model traces persist output and retain API response separately.
Remaining unmeasured or blocked hotspots are explicit.

task_endpoint_reliability_audit.description: Audit and improve performance across the full Local AI Hub: recurring MCP/API, retrieval/RAG, embeddings/reranking, cache, indexing, scheduler, IPC and preprocessing. Measure before changes; preserve endpoint reliability, response contracts, GPU fencing, existing user changes, explicit provider choices and CPU fallback. Assess GPU/iGPU/NPU and Rust/Cython only against measured bottlenecks. Include prior endpoint trace, Trace Inspector and HTTP model-output capture work.
task_endpoint_reliability_audit.next_action: Attribute remaining repo search and queue costs; profile API, caches, scheduler and indexing with bounded workloads; implement further changes only for repeatable bottlenecks. Finish GPU/iGPU/NPU and Rust/Cython assessment; verify current source after the user's restart.

results.summary: 61 focused MCP/schema tests pass; git diff --check clean. Contract validation warm microbenchmark p50 338.328ms to 39.834ms per 1000 warm calls across 9 samples (8.49x); no endpoint latency claim. EndpointStatsStore p50 0.096ms vs 13.748ms fresh connection (143x), 10 focused tests pass. RAG warm SQLite reuse p50 4.227ms to 3.436ms; repo archive path check 1.706ms to 0.042ms. Candidate validation 600 files, 7 pairs: sequential p50 225.430ms vs 8 workers 168.213ms (~25%), order preserved.

Current synthetic 100-file/10k-RAG benchmark passed in 15.4s, 3 comparison samples, 7 light samples, concurrency 1/4, inference skipped, 5/5 supported quality checks. Warm RAG search p50/p95 2.60/2.82ms; batch index 214.8/244.5ms; CodeIndex 48.1/113.0ms; queue admission concurrency4 70.7/80.8ms; context pack 37.4/56.1ms. 10k-file case stopped by CodeIndex size budget.

Two lexical repo search calls: 820.5ms and 596.3ms; candidate discovery 626.6/415ms, Git inventory 391.3/175.4ms, project iteration 235.3/239.5ms, path validation 187.0/192.7ms. Direct Git inventory 111.1ms cold/2.27ms warm over 2,095 paths. Worker sweep mixed: 4 vs 8 workers p50 59.9 vs 64.5ms for 256 files; 135.5 vs 140.7ms for 600; four concurrent 600-file searches 597.6 vs 587.1ms. No worker change. Candidate-limit guard passes.

Follow-up worktree measurements: BGE small embedding batch of 8, CPU median 72.04ms vs CUDA 79.82ms; BGE reranker batch of 8, CPU 756.78ms vs CUDA 302.66ms. Worktree candidate search median 146.04ms; installed live search 44.46s is not comparable because installed source hash differs. No provider change or model pull.
